$comment: Drop this in a project root and Claude Code or Cursor picks ReqKeeper up as an agent tool.
Six tools. Three read. propose_payment writes locally but passes no approval, so it always
stops at AWAITING_APPROVAL. resolve_pending only drains the outbox and has no send path.
settle_obligation is the one tool that can dispatch, and it cannot supply its own authority:
the approval is read from the store by plan hash, and nothing on this surface can write one.
A human runs `npm run approve` at a CLI. That is the whole security model and it is a
structural absence, not a permission check.
KEEPERHUB_API_KEY is the only credential the settle path needs. The server refuses to start
without it and writes only to stderr, so stdout stays clean for JSON-RPC.
